environment.description: Same Rails 7.1 application deployed behind Cloudflare with a custom Transform Rule that inspects JSON request bodies on PATCH/PUT methods to /api/v1/users/* endpoints. The rule uses a Cloudflare Worker (deployed as a managed ruleset action) that parses the JSON body and strips any key matching 'role' from the request payload before forwarding to origin. Additionally, the admin dashboard assets are served via a separate CDN path with Subresource Integrity enforcement at the browser level (Content-Security-Policy: require-sri-for script) AND a Cloudflare Page Rule that adds `Content-Security-Policy: require-sri-for script style` header to all HTML responses. The SRI hashes are pinned in the HTML template and any tampered admin_panel.js (e.g., injected via XSS to call the promote endpoint) would fail integrity checks and not execute. The Worker transform rule ID is cf-worker-param-sanitizer-a3f8 and operates on the edge before TLS termination to origin.

config.cloudflare_worker: cf-worker-param-sanitizer-a3f8 strips 'role' key from JSON body on PATCH/PUT to /api/v1/users/*
config.sri_enforcement: all script tags include integrity attribute with sha384 hashes
config.page_rule: *.example.com/* adds CSP header with require-sri-for directive
